Information cutoff: 2025-04-01. Fiscal period: 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31. All amounts USD.


## Business and comparability

Global beverage company with concentrate and finished-product operations. Bottling arrangements and refranchising affect comparisons with integrated peers.


## Reported financial performance

Revenue: $47,061,000,000; annual growth: 2.86%. Operating margin: 21.23%; selected peer median: 16.88% (n=3, including this issuer).

Current ratio: 1.03x; liabilities/assets: 73.77%. Operating cash flow margin: 14.46%; free cash flow margin: 10.07%.

The 2024 filing attributes the operating cash flow decline primarily to a $6.0 billion IRS tax litigation deposit, alongside currency, tax and refranchising effects. Reported cash flow is retained without adding the deposit back.
